name: Weapons
description: The Elder Scrolls Arena canonical weapon types, cultural origins, and martial descriptions

entries.content: Staff: A sturdy wooden or metal-shod haft favored by traveling mages, monks, and hermits across Tamriel. While humble in appearance, in trained hands it delivers sweeping blows and serves as a natural conduit for channeling sorcery.
Dagger: A compact, double-edged thrusting blade easily concealed beneath cloaks and tunics. The universal sidearm of assassins, rogues, and common folk throughout the Empire.

Shortsword: A nimble, balanced cutting and thrusting blade. Prized by skirmishers and guardsmen for fighting in cramped dungeon corridors and narrow tavern hallways where longer blades would foul on the walls.
Broadsword: A wide, heavy military blade designed for formidable slashing power against unarmored and lightly armored foes. A staple weapon among garrison troops and mercenaries.
Saber: A single-edged curved cavalry sword originating in Hammerfell and Elsweyr. Its curved geometry enables devastating draw-cuts and fluid, sweeping strikes in open terrain.

Longsword: The archetypal knightly blade of High Rock and Cyrodiil. Straight, double-edged, and finely cross-guarded, offering an ideal balance between reach, defensive parrying, and lethal thrusting.

Claymore: A massive two-handed greatsword forged in the freezing highlands of Skyrim. Wielded with both hands, its sheer momentum can cleave through shields, splinter hafted weapons, and crush armored infantry.
Tanto: A traditional Akaviri single-edged dagger with a reinforced chisel point. Highly sought after by thieves and duelists for its ability to slide between overlapping armor scales.
Wakizashi: A medium Akaviri companion sword worn at the waist alongside the katana. Renowned for its razor edge, swift recovery, and deadly efficacy in close-quarters skirmishes.

Katana: An elegant curved Akaviri long blade folded by master smiths. Designed for lightning-fast drawing and precision cutting, it remains the hallmark weapon of elite Imperial Dragonguard and blade masters.

Dai-katana: An enormous two-handed Akaviri war sword with an elongated curved blade and two-handed hilt. It requires disciplined footwork and delivers tremendous kinetic cutting arcs across the battlefield.
Mace: A heavy flanged or spiked metal club. Designed specifically to shatter bone and concuss foes through heavy plate armor where edged weapons might glance harmlessly off.
Flail: A spiked metal ball attached to a sturdy haft by an iron chain. The swinging head wraps around enemy shields and parrying weapons to deliver unexpected crushing blows.
War hammer: A brutal two-handed pole hammer featuring a heavy crushing face backed by an armor-piercing spike. A single solid strike can cave in breastplates and stagger towering beasts.
War axe: A single-handed cleaving weapon with a broad, curved iron or steel beard. Favored by Nord raiders and Redguard warriors for its aggressive chopping power and shield-hooking utility.
Battle axe: A massive two-handed executioner's war axe. The wide heavy head concentrates immense force into every swing, cleaving armor, wood, and flesh alike.
Short bow: A light recurve bow crafted from flexible yew or ash. Quick to draw and easy to maneuver in thick forests, subterranean caverns, and mounted combat.
Long bow: A tall, powerful wooden bow with exceptional draw weight. Capable of launching heavy bodkin arrows across vast distances with enough velocity to pierce armor at long range.
